'''Adora Aybara''' was [[Perrin]]'s sister.

== Murder ==
She was killed by [[Padan Fain]] at age sixteen alongside her father and mother, [[Con Aybara|Con]] and [[Joslyn Aybara]], and [[Paet]], her brother, and [[Deselle]], her sister. Their deaths are blamed on Trollocs.{{ref/book|4|29}}

== Namesake ==
Adora is also the name of Perrin and [[Faile]]'s hypothetical [[Adora Aybara (granddaughter of Perrin)|granddaughter]] in one of the visions of possible futures that [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] experiences while confronting the [[Dark One]], presumably named for Perrin's late sister.
